styles.label: 贴耳加强
styles.tip: 嘴离耳约 1.7 cm，另一只耳朵几乎听不到，不加房间，左右耳慢慢穿梭
styles.tip_en: Mouth ≈1.7 cm from the ear, far ear almost silent, no room, slow sweeps between the ears

styles.label: KU100 实录
styles.tip: 模拟 KU100 近耳轻语。贴近时带出原声里细微的呼吸，控制响齿音和低频气流。声源在耳边和身前随机停留，远耳保留实测房间声。
styles.tip_en: Models close whispers on a KU100. Brings out quiet breath as the voice draws near, with controlled sibilance and low-frequency air pulses. The voice pauses near either ear or in front, with measured room sound in the far ear.

styles.label: 掏耳
styles.tip: 给棉签、挖耳勺、刮擦这类触发音用（不是给人声用的）：声源伸进耳道进进出出，带耳道共鸣、耳内低频和堵耳的闷感，另一只耳朵基本听不到，每只耳朵约 15 秒换一次边。降噪会把这类声音当噪声压掉，请把降噪关掉或调低
styles.tip_en: For trigger sounds such as cotton swabs and scratching (not for voice). Turn denoise off or down

styles.label: 呼吸音
styles.tip: 突出录音里贴近耳边的吸气和呼气。
styles.tip_en: Brings out close-miked inhalations and exhalations in the recording.

denoise.label: 降噪
denoise.tip: 输入降噪（RNNoise，纯 CPU）：在空间化之前去掉底噪。数值 = 底噪最多压低多少分贝，0 = 关闭，100 = 不设上限；60 以上基本没有区别。人声的音量不变；开启后延迟增加 20 ms。网页里的声音一般很干净，不用开
denoise.tip_en: Input denoise (RNNoise): removes background noise before spatialization. The value is how many dB the noise is lowered by at most; 0 = off, 100 = no limit. Adds 20 ms of latency

manual.label: 手动摆位：关闭自动移动，拖动位置图里的声源
manual.label_en: Manual: stop automatic motion and drag the source on the map
manual.tip: 打开后，穿梭、忽远忽近、自动上下、自然晃动全部停掉，声源停在你摆的位置：在位置图里点或拖改方位和距离，在右侧竖条上拖改高度（双击竖条回到与耳朵齐平）。播放中打开时，声源就停在此刻所在的位置
manual.tip_en: When on, all automatic motion stops and the source stays where you put it: tap or drag on the map for direction and distance, drag the bar at the right for height (double-tap it for ear level)

items.label: 左右双人
items.tip: 把网页里的声音当成两个人：同一个声音一个在左耳、一个在右耳（各自忽远忽近），第 2 个整体晚这么多毫秒，听得出是两个人一前一后地说。30 ms 以下两边容易融成一个声音（听起来偏在先到的那一边），50–120 ms 像两个人，150 ms 以上像回声。只有第 2 个声音晚，第 1 个和平时一样及时。打开时排布默认是「一起移动」（按「左右移动」一起走、始终相对），可以再改回各自固定。和电脑版「文件转换」页的左右双人是同一个设置。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Turns the page's voice into two people: the same voice at the left ear and at the right ear (each sways near and far on its own), the second one this many milliseconds later. Below about 30 ms the two tend to fuse into one voice; 50–120 ms sounds like two people; above 150 ms it sounds like an echo. Only the second voice is delayed. Turning it on sets Layout to Together (both follow Left / right motion, always opposite); you can switch back to Fixed. Same setting as Two voices on the desktop app's File tab. 0 = off

items.label: 排布
items.tip: 各自固定：1 号固定在左耳、2 号固定在右耳，只做忽远忽近、上下、自然晃动，「左右移动」不起作用。一起移动：两个声音按「左右移动」的方式一起走，始终在头的两侧相对（一个贴左耳时另一个贴右耳）
items.tip_en: Fixed: voice 1 stays at the left ear and voice 2 at the right, with only near / far sway, up / down and micro motion; Left / right motion is inactive. Together: both follow Left / right motion and always stay on opposite sides

items.label: 自动平衡
items.tip: 让两个声音每一段时间听起来都差不多一样响（各自忽远忽近时，常常一个退开了另一个正贴着耳朵）。按两个声音此刻听起来多响往平均拉，最多 ±15 dB，0.25 秒平滑；停顿里不往上拉。网页没有「整段」，响度边听边算。100% = 一样响，50% = 差距减半，0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Keeps the two voices about equally loud at every moment, at most ±15 dB, smoothed over 0.25 s; voices in a pause are not lifted. Loudness is measured as the audio plays. 100% = equal, 50% = half the gap, 0 = off

items.text: 1 号（橙）在左耳、2 号（蓝）在右耳，位置图上能看到两个声音。各自固定时「左右移动」和手动摆位不起作用；开 / 关、换排布的那一下会重新开始。
items.text_en: Voice 1 (orange) at the left ear, voice 2 (blue) at the right; both show on the map. With Fixed, Left / right motion and manual positioning are inactive; turning it on or off or changing the layout restarts it.

items.label: 贴耳距离
items.tip: 嘴离耳朵多远。1.7 cm = 贴着耳朵
items.tip_en: How far the mouth is from the ear. 1.7 cm = touching

items.label: 远耳压低
items.tip: 贴耳时另一只耳朵额外压低多少（0 = 纯物理，像真实 KU100）
items.tip_en: Extra attenuation of the far ear when close (0 = pure physics)

items.label: 临场感
items.tip: 贴耳时近耳 3.5 kHz 和空气感
items.tip_en: Near-ear 3.5 kHz presence and air

items.label: 暗度
items.tip: 贴耳时近耳 5 kHz 附近压低，音色更暗、更柔
items.tip_en: Dip around 5 kHz at the near ear: darker, softer

items.label: 温暖感
items.tip: 凑近时两耳共同的低频
items.tip_en: Low-frequency warmth in both ears when close

items.label: 近耳低频
items.tip: 贴耳时只给近耳加的低频
items.tip_en: Bass added only to the near ear

items.label: 远耳低频削减
items.tip: 贴耳时远耳 320 Hz 以下再压低
items.tip_en: Extra cut below 320 Hz at the far ear

items.label: 气声增强
items.tip: 原声中轻微送气和呼吸声的最大增益，响亮的齿音不会得到额外增强。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Maximum gain for soft breath sounds in the recording. Loud sibilants receive no extra gain. 0 = off

items.label: 薄声补偿
items.tip: 呼吸低频偏少时补气流，3 kHz 以上过亮时柔化。0 = 关闭。
items.tip_en: Fills in missing low-frequency airflow and softens excess brightness above 3 kHz. 0 = off.

items.label: 呼吸去闷
items.tip: 呼吸在 100–300 Hz 的能量过强时，最多压低多少分贝。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Maximum attenuation when a breath has excess energy at 100–300 Hz. 0 = off

items.label: 近处气声范围
items.tip: 在身前和耳侧近处保留多少比例的气声增强。0 = 仅贴耳，1 = 近处可用全部增益。声源离头中心 20 cm 内最强，渐弱至 65 cm 消失。低频气流仍只在贴耳时生效
items.tip_en: Fraction of breath lift available in front of and beside the head. 0 = at the ear only, 1 = full lift nearby. Strongest within 20 cm of the head centre, fading out at 65 cm. Low-frequency air puffs still require close ear contact

items.label: 气流扑耳
items.tip: 送气时气流扑到耳朵上的低频脉冲（耳朵痒的感觉），由嗓音自己的送气声导出。0 = 关闭，1 倍 = 标准；滑块到 8 倍，手输可更高
items.tip_en: Low-frequency pulses of breath hitting the ear, derived from the voice's own aspiration. 0 = off, 1x = standard; slider up to 8x, type for higher values

items.label: 耳甲共鸣
items.tip: 贴耳时近耳 4.3 kHz 的耳甲腔共振（KU100 贴耳实录的共有特征）。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: 4.3 kHz concha resonance at the near ear when close. 0 = off

items.label: 贴耳轻声
items.tip: 凑到耳边时把嗓音均衡成「放轻声音」，退开时恢复（只做均衡）。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: EQ towards a lowered voice when at the ear, back to normal when away (EQ only). 0 = off

items.label: 嘴的大小
items.tip: 嘴是一个开口而不是一个点：贴耳时耳廓的窄谷被平均变浅，离远了没有区别。0 = 点声源
items.tip_en: The mouth is an opening, not a point: narrow pinna notches smooth out when close. 0 = point source

items.label: 远耳高频遮挡
items.tip: 贴耳时另一只耳朵 6 kHz 以上再压低（近处声源的头影更深）。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Extra cut above 6 kHz at the far ear when close (deeper head shadow for near sources). 0 = off

items.label: 近耳用 KU100 实测校正曲线（高频更收）
入耳深度
items.tip: 声源贴到耳朵上之后，最深伸进耳道多少。0 = 不进耳道，这一组都不起作用。给棉签、挖耳勺、刮擦这类触发音用；只有贴在耳朵上时才会伸进去，换边前先退出来
items.tip_en: How far the source goes into the ear canal once it is at the ear. 0 = never enters, and this whole group is off. Meant for trigger sounds (cotton swab, ear pick, scratching); it only goes in while at the ear and comes out before changing ears

items.label: 进出节奏
items.tip: 有声音时，一次「伸进去—退出来」大约几秒（KU100 掏耳实录 2–6 秒）
items.tip_en: Seconds of sound per in-and-out stroke (KU100 ear-cleaning recordings: 2–6 s)

items.label: 随机程度
items.tip: 0 = 进出的节奏和深浅固定，1 = 都随机，偶尔只伸到一半、偶尔整个拿出来
items.tip_en: 0 = fixed rhythm and depth, 1 = random, sometimes only halfway in, sometimes fully out

items.label: 耳道共鸣
items.tip: 伸进耳道后，物体与话筒（鼓膜）之间那段耳道的共振峰：伸得越深共振越高（约 3 → 11 kHz），听得出进出的深浅。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Resonance of the part of the canal left between the object and the microphone (eardrum): the deeper, the higher (≈3 → 11 kHz), which is what makes the depth audible. 0 = off

items.label: 耳内低频
items.tip: 摩擦 / 触碰在耳道里形成的低频压力（隆隆声），由输入自己的包络导出，不加噪声。0 = 关闭，1 倍 = 标准（比摩擦声高约 15 dB，实录 10–20 dB）。输入本身低频就重（直接摩擦话筒录的）时调低
items.tip_en: Low-frequency pressure (rumble) that rubbing and touching build up inside the canal, derived from the input's own envelope, no noise added. 0 = off, 1x = standard (≈15 dB above the friction sound; recordings: 10–20 dB). Turn it down if the input is already bass-heavy (recorded by rubbing the microphone itself)

items.label: 堵耳闷感
items.tip: 伸进耳道时近耳 2.5 kHz 以上压低多少：物体堵住了耳道口，声音更闷。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Cut above 2.5 kHz at the near ear while inside the canal: the object blocks the entrance, so it sounds more muffled. 0 = off

items.text: 入耳深度为 0 时这一组不起作用。人声用的气声增强、气流扑耳、忽远忽近等，掏耳时建议关掉（点上面的「掏耳」一键设置）
items.text_en: This group is inactive while the depth is 0. For ear cleaning, use the Ear cleaning style button

items.label: 移动频率
items.tip: 说话时每分钟换几次耳朵（同时缩放停留和移动时间）
items.tip_en: Ear switches per minute of speech (scales hold and move time)

items.label: 换气时换边
items.tip: 在一侧停够设定时间后，等换气间隙再移动。
items.tip_en: After the hold time has elapsed, wait for a gap between breaths to move.

items.label: 停留时间
items.tip: 每只耳朵边停留多久（掏耳时一般几十秒）
items.tip_en: How long it stays at each ear (tens of seconds for ear cleaning)

items.label: 移动时间
items.tip: 从一只耳朵移到另一只耳朵用多久
items.tip_en: How long a crossing takes

items.label: 随机程度
items.tip: 时长和落点的随机程度：0 = 完全规律
items.tip_en: Randomness of timing and landing spots: 0 = strictly regular

items.label: 正面比例
items.tip: 每次停下来，有多大比例停在正前方（两只耳朵听到的差不多），其余停在耳边、侧前、侧后。KU100 轻语实录里约三成的时间两耳差不多
items.tip_en: Share of the stops that land in front (both ears about equal); the rest land at an ear, front-side or back-side. In KU100 whisper recordings both ears are about equal for roughly 30% of the time

items.label: 从远处凑近
items.tip: 换边时先退到约 0.5 m 再慢慢凑近的概率
items.tip_en: Chance that a switch backs off to ≈0.5 m and then looms in

items.label: 贴耳角度
items.tip: 90 = 正侧方，100 = 略靠后
items.tip_en: 90 = straight to the side, 100 = slightly behind

items.label: 穿过时的距离
items.tip: 经过脸前 / 脑后时离头中心多远
items.tip_en: Distance from the head centre while crossing

items.label: 方位角
items.tip_en: 0 front, 90 right, 180 back, 270 left

items.label: 方位角
items.tip: 0 前，90 右，180 后，270 左。也可以直接在左边的位置图上拖
items.tip_en: 0 front, 90 right, 180 back, 270 left. Or drag on the map at the left

items.label: 离头距离
items.tip: 声源离头表面多远；在耳朵正侧方时就是离耳朵多远
items.tip_en: Distance from the head surface; at the side this is the distance from the ear

items.label: 高度
items.tip: 以耳朵为支点向上（正）/ 向下（负）偏多少度。也可以拖位置图右侧的竖条
items.tip_en: Above (+) / below (−) the ear, in degrees. Or drag the bar at the right of the map

items.label: 响度随位置变化
items.tip: 1 = 物理真实（贴耳很响、到脸前会弱很多），0 = 处处一样响
items.tip_en: 1 = physical (loud at the ear, much quieter in front), 0 = constant

items.text: 手动：声源停在你摆的位置，在上面的位置图上拖动。忽远忽近、上下、自然晃动此时不起作用
items.text_en: Manual: the source stays where you put it; drag it on the map. Near / far sway, up / down and micro motion are inactive

actions.label: 雨夜
actions.tip: 四面八方的小到中雨（约 2 mm/h），重心绕着头慢慢转（8D 环绕）；身边地上的落地声比参考的 8D 雨声轻一点；不隔窗、没有屋檐滴水；雨声比人声低约 18 dB。只改背景音这几项
actions.tip_en: Light-to-moderate rain all around you, its centre slowly circling your head (8D surround); landing drops a little softer than the 8D reference; 18 dB below the voice. Only changes the background settings

items.text: 实时生成，不是录音；人声不受影响
items.text_en: Generated live, not a recording; the voice is untouched

items.label: 音量
items.tip: 雨声比人声的目标响度低多少：1 = 低 40 dB，100 = 一样响；0 = 关闭。整片雨声按这个定响度，落地声和滴水在它之上
items.tip_en: How far below the voice's target loudness the rain sits: 1 = 40 dB below, 100 = as loud; 0 = off

items.label: 雨量
items.tip: 毛毛雨（0.3 mm/h）… 暴雨（60 mm/h）。雨越大，大雨滴越多、越密、越低沉，落地声也越多；也会响一点（±5 dB）
items.tip_en: Drizzle (0.3 mm/h) … downpour (60 mm/h)

items.label: 左右
items.tip: 雨从哪边来：−100 = 都在左边，0 = 四周均匀，100 = 都在右边（比如窗户在右边）
items.tip_en: Where the rain comes from: −100 = all on the left, 0 = evenly around, 100 = all on the right

items.label: 包围感
items.tip: 0 = 只从一个方向来（「左右」定的那个方向），100 = 从四面八方来
items.tip_en: 0 = from a single direction, 100 = from all around

items.label: 流动
items.tip: 雨声的重心绕着头慢慢转（8D 环绕，平均 26 秒一圈，快慢随机）：那个方向的雨落得密一些。0 = 不动，50 = 和参考的 8D 雨声一样，100 = 更明显
items.tip_en: The rain's centre slowly circles your head (8D surround). 0 = still, 50 = like the 8D reference, 100 = stronger

items.label: 隔窗
items.tip: 0 = 站在雨里，100 = 关着窗在屋里听：墙和玻璃挡掉高频，只剩闷闷的雨声；落地声一起闷掉，屋檐滴水挡一半
items.tip_en: 0 = standing in the rain, 100 = indoors with the window shut

items.label: 落地声
items.tip: 身边地上一个个雨点「噗」的一声（低沉、短促，按 HRTF 摆在四周地上）有多明显：0 = 没有，60 ≈ 参考的 8D 雨声，每格 0.2 dB；雨越大落得越多。屋檐滴水的响度也跟着它
items.tip_en: How noticeable the single drops landing around you are: 0 = none, 60 ≈ the 8D reference, 0.2 dB per step. Eave drips follow this loudness too

items.label: 屋檐滴水
items.tip: 屋檐往石阶 / 积水的地上滴的「嗒」：1–3 处固定的位置，各有各的节奏，溅水声高低不同。越大滴得越快、地方越多；0 = 没有。多响跟着「落地声」，落地声为 0 时听不到
items.tip_en: Drips from the eaves onto wet stone: 1–3 fixed spots. 0 = none. Loudness follows Landing drops

items.label: 雷声
items.tip: 远处的雷（可选，默认没有）：曲折的闪电通道上每一段发出一个激波，按距离先后到达、按 HRTF 从天上各个方向来，远的只剩低沉的隆隆声，还有地形的回声。0 = 没有；越大越近、越频繁、越响：30 ≈ 两分钟一次、5 km 外，50 ≈ 77 秒、3.5 km，100 ≈ 25 秒、1.5 km
items.tip_en: Distant thunder (optional, off by default). 0 = none; higher = closer, more frequent and louder: 30 ≈ every 2 min at 5 km, 100 ≈ every 25 s at 1.5 km

items.label: 幅度
items.tip: 随机地凑近、往后让的幅度（0 = 关闭）
items.tip_en: How far it leans in and out (0 = off)

items.label: 节奏
items.tip: 说话时一次凑近—退开大约几秒
items.tip_en: Seconds of speech per lean-out / lean-in cycle

items.label: 随机程度
items.tip: 0 = 固定节奏和深浅，1 = 时长和深浅都随机
items.tip_en: 0 = fixed rhythm and depth, 1 = random timing and depth

items.label: 跟随音量
items.tip: 声音大时往后让、轻声时更贴近，听着更舒服
items.tip_en: Louder → leans back, softer → comes closer; more comfortable

items.label: 退开时的音量
items.tip: 退开时耳边音量保留物理衰减的比例（真人退开会说大声一点；KU100 实录 0.4–0.56）
items.tip_en: Share of the physical level drop kept when leaning back (talkers raise their voice; KU100 recordings 0.4–0.56)

items.label: 停顿时的动作
items.tip: 停顿时动作的速度：0.13 = 几乎不动，下一句从原位置接着说；1 = 一直在动
items.tip_en: Motion speed during pauses: 0.13 = almost still, 1 = always moving

items.label: 自然晃动
items.tip: 人体自然的微小晃动（1 约 1.2 cm）
items.tip_en: Natural small body sway (1 ≈ 1.2 cm)

items.label: 高度
items.tip: 嘴相对耳朵向上（正）/ 向下（负）偏多少度，离耳朵的距离不变；0 = 与耳朵齐平
items.tip_en: Mouth above (+) / below (−) the ear, in degrees, at the same distance from the ear; 0 = level with the ear

items.label: 自动上下
items.tip: 嘴在耳朵上方 / 下方之间慢慢换位置的幅度（0 = 关闭）
items.tip_en: How far the mouth drifts above / below the ear on its own (0 = off)

items.label: 节奏
items.tip: 说话时上下一个来回大约几秒
items.tip_en: Seconds of speech per up / down cycle

items.label: 随机程度
items.tip: 0 = 节奏和高低固定，1 = 时长和高低都随机
items.tip_en: 0 = fixed rhythm and height, 1 = random timing and height

items.label: 从头顶绕
items.tip: 换耳时改成从头顶绕过去的概率（穿梭 / 随机走位）：0 = 只从脸前 / 脑后绕，1 = 每次都从头顶绕
items.tip_en: Chance that an ear switch goes over the top of the head (sweep / random): 0 = front / back only, 1 = always over the top

items.text: 上下比左右、远近弱，因人而异；气声、轻语更明显
items.text_en: Height is a weaker cue than left / right or distance and varies between listeners

items.label: 固定原声底噪
items.tip: 让原录音里的稳定底噪留在固定空间，人声和呼吸继续随声源移动。合成雨声单独调节。
items.tip_en: Keeps steady background sound from the recording in place as the voice and breath move. Generated rain has its own controls.

items.label: 真实房间（KU100 实测，远耳听到的是房间声而不是寂静）
items.label_en: Real room (measured with a KU100: the far ear hears the room, not silence)

items.label: 耳廓
items.tip: KU100：人工头自己的耳廓（按平均人耳做的，给别人听选这个最稳）；真人 A–G：HUTUBS 实测的真人耳廓，自己听时挑前后、上下最分得清的那只
items.tip_en: KU100: the dummy head's own ear (safest for an audience). Human A–G: measured human ears; pick the one with the clearest front/back and up/down

items.label: 回放补偿
items.tip: 扩散场：通用；KU100 原机：和真实 KU100 录音一样（高频略暗）；或按你的耳机型号补偿
items.tip_en: Diffuse: generic; Native: like a real KU100 recording; or pick your headphone model

items.label: 去齿音
items.tip: 只在 s / sh / x 出现时压低 4.5 kHz 以上，最多压这么多
items.tip_en: Ducks >4.5 kHz only on sibilants, by at most this much

items.label: 强辅音柔化
items.tip: 强辅音突出时，最多压低 5 kHz 附近窄频带这么多，保留轻微呼吸的细节。0 = 关闭
items.tip_en: Attenuates a narrow band around 5 kHz by up to this much on prominent consonants, preserving quiet breath detail. 0 = off

items.label: 轻声化
items.tip: 把嗓音均衡成「压低声音说话」（只做均衡，不改嗓音）
items.tip_en: EQ towards a lowered-voice spectrum (EQ only)

items.label: 自动响度（实时 / 试听：慢慢把音量拉到目标）
items.label_en: Auto level (real-time / preview: slowly rides to the target)

items.label: 输出增益
items.tip: 在自动响度之后、峰值限制器之前整体加减音量，相当于耳机音量旋钮。只在实时 / 试听时起作用；转换文件不用它，文件的响度精确归一化到「目标响度」。往上推到峰值上限后只会被限制器压扁，不会更响
items.tip_en: Overall gain after auto level and before the peak limiter, like a headphone volume knob. Real-time / preview only; file conversion ignores it and normalizes exactly to the target loudness. Above the ceiling the limiter only squashes it, it won't get louder

items.label: 峰值上限
items.tip: 限制器的真峰值上限
items.tip_en: True-peak ceiling of the limiter

items.label: 随机种子
items.tip: 换一个数字就换一套走位（下次开始播放时生效）
items.tip_en: A different number gives a different path (applies when playback restarts)
